tm.「おや そなたも 夜の散歩か？\n なんでも 浜辺のほうで\n 踊りの宴が 開か: "Oh, an evening stroll? They say a dance party is being held on the beach.
tm.「いいなあ……。見てよ あの 身のこなし！\n あんな すばやく キレイに動けた: "I'm so jealous. Look at that agility! If I moved so quickly and cleanly, the instructor wouldn't scold me.
tm.「……いつ 魔王の手下たちが この町に\n 攻めこんできたって おかしくないだろ: "Aren't the Dark One's minions likely to attack this town any time? So I train even now.
tm.「僕も 一刻も早く 強くなって\n 町のみんなを 守れるようになりたいんだ。\n: "I want to get strong fast and protect everyone in town. I haven't a moment to rest from training.
tm.「なぜか ハネの人に 訓練を指導されてるんだ。\n 見かけによらず この人 すご: "For some reason a winged person is instructing us. They're surprisingly strong and strict. Who are they?
tm.「このハネの人たち 強くて面白くて\n おまけに 歌って踊れて 楽器もできるなん: "These winged people are strong and fun, and they sing, dance, and play instruments too! They must be amazing!
